progdir=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1792545201/attempts/077c639e3ede471faa305f8b7291dc1f/system/state/workspace/programs')

source='''from collections import Counter\n\ndef transform(grid):\n    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])\n    out = []\n    for r in range(0, h, 3):\n        row = []\n        for c in range(0, w, 3):\n            counts = Counter(v for line in grid[r:r+3] for v in line[c:c+3] if v not in (0, 5))\n            row.append(counts.most_common(1)[0][0] if counts else 0)\n        out.append(row)\n    return out\n'''
